description: This file defines a Swift module for managing push relay registration state, including loading, saving, and clearing registration info and related key IDs. It interacts with a KeychainStore for persistent storage.

classes.name: StoredPushRelayRegistrationState
classes.description: A Codable struct representing the stored push relay registration state data.

classes.name: PushRelayRegistrationStore
classes.description: A static structure providing methods to load, save, and clear registration state and key IDs related to push relay.

methods.name: loadRegistrationState
methods.description: Loads the registration state from the keychain and decodes it into a RegistrationState struct.

methods.name: saveRegistrationState
methods.description: Encodes and saves the provided RegistrationState into the keychain.

methods.name: clearRegistrationState
methods.description: Deletes the registration state from the keychain.

methods.name: loadAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Retrieves the App Attest Key ID from the keychain.

methods.name: saveAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Saves the App Attest Key ID into the keychain.

methods.name: clearAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Deletes the App Attest Key ID from the keychain.

methods.name: loadAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Retrieves the Attested Key ID from the keychain.

methods.name: saveAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Saves the Attested Key ID into the keychain.

methods.name: clearAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Deletes the Attested Key ID from the keychain.
